summary: The apt_repository module adds or removes APT repositories on Debian and Ubuntu, supports Debian 6 and later, and is deprecated in favor of deb822_repository (removed in 2.25).
questions: How do I add an APT source with Ansible?

answer_card.title: apt_repository module (deprecated)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.apt_repository` adds/removes APT repositories on Debian (6+) and Ubuntu. It is **deprecated** and will be removed in 2.25; use `ansible.builtin.deb822_repository` instead.
